title: Water Damage Mitigation Payment Desk Terms: Customer Payments and Card Surcharge
content:
These payment desk terms govern customer payments posted to a Water Damage Mitigation job and the surcharge on credit card payments.

## Terms in force
1. The job must not be closed when a customer payment is posted.
2. A payment made by credit card carries a surcharge of the credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, booked as its own line against that payment and rounded to the cent, half up; debit card, ACH and check payments carry no surcharge, and insurance proceeds are never surcharged.
3. A payment larger than the balance creates a credit balance that is refunded, never applied to another job.

## Retired clause
The following clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for customer payment tenders and posting, and is kept here as a record only:

> Customer payments are accepted by credit card, debit card, ACH or check and are posted in full to the one job they name.

## Surcharge by tender
| Tender | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| Credit card | the tier's credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, as a separate line against that payment |
| Debit card | none |
| ACH | none |
| Check | none |
| Insurance proceeds | never surcharged |

## Worked figure (hypothetical surcharge of 3 percent)
A credit card payment of $412.50 carries a surcharge line of $12.38: 3 percent of $412.50 is $12.375, rounded to the cent, half up.

## Overpayment
A payment above the job's balance leaves the job with a credit balance; that credit is refunded and is never applied to another job.

superseded_clauses: Customer payments are accepted by credit card, debit card, ACH or check and are posted in full to the one job they name.
